name: floating-bokeh-orbs
title: Floating Bokeh Orbs
description: Soft cinematic out-of-focus luminous bokeh orbs drifting lazily in deep field perspective.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Luxury
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Airy
Shape: Pill
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Neon On Dark

## Rules

- Passive Bokeh Ambiance: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
